title: Moments After Executing His Neighbor
description:
On July 9th, 2022, officers responded to a report of shots being fired. The 911 caller reported that as she and her husband were returning home when their neighbour pulled out a gun and started shooting at them. The officers did their best to treat the wounded until the medics arrived. Shortly after, the medics arrived on the scene to treat the victims. Based on the information provided by the neighbours, the officers were close to apprehending the suspect's son and his girlfriend, who had assisted him after the shooting. One of the officers noticed the suspect's son and his girlfriend circling the crime scene and swiftly took action. Meanwhile, the female was transported to the hospital. The woman provided the police with more details about the incident. Soon, all the three suspects were interviewed about the incident. Unfortunately, the woman's boyfriend succumbed to his injuries, but the police were able to extract crucial information from both the victims and the suspects. Here's what the daughter of the suspect's son told the police. Here’s what the suspect’s son told the police. The male was charged with first-degree murder, attempt to commit a felony, tampering with evidence and conspiracy to commit tampering with evidence while his son was charged with conspiracy to commit a third-degree felony, possession of firearms by a felon and tampering with evidence.
